pages.title: Brewing Station
pages.text: The Alchemy Pot is the heart of Gensokyo's alchemy. It has 12 item slots and a 1000 mB fluid tank, and can handle alchemy, brewing and the rest.

$(bold)Using the pot$()$(br)Right-click with a fluid container to fill or drain the tank, or with an item to add ingredients. Right-click with an empty hand to take back the last item, and sneak-right-click to empty everything out of the pot — which destroys the fluid inside as well.$(br2)The pot hints at the ingredients the current recipe accepts; the complete recipe list is under Alchemy Pot in JEI.
